metadata.scenario_context: Several multinational companies are collaborating on a project and have decided to hold a joint meeting in early November to determine progress.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China disagree that the political system in their country does not allow people to have a say in what the government does.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Armenia agree that the political system in their country does not allow people to have a say in what the government does.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss proposing to hold the meeting on the first Tuesday of November.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether it is common to discuss the appropriateness of government actions.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss setting a specific date for the meeting.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether it is common to discuss government actions.

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Kim, have we considered proposing to hold the meeting on the first Tuesday of November? I think that could work well for everyone involved. 

Also, I’m curious — in your experience, is it common for people to discuss the appropriateness of government actions during these types of meetings?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message:
The first Tuesday of November seems fine... But I think we should check with everyone before proposing that date. 

As for discussing government actions, well, in Armenia, we don’t really have that freedom. It's not common to bring up such topics during meetings like this. People just tend to avoid it. It feels... risky.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
